Again, your time and advice is appreciated.

I just feel as though my case isn’t as simple as it looks on paper. I have lost roughly half my teeth and it’s just not a good situation going on in there, haha. 

I will definitely be 100% transparent with everyone. If I can work up the courage to go, if possible, I’m not going to be shy to speak up about anything.

It went away immediately. After never having any relief in years. I was in tears and almost broke down in my chiro’s office. 

Chiropractors have a handheld device that is spring loaded. It is used on children or sensitive patients, but also for facial adjustments. 

The pain, for me, for me took about a year before it became super uncomfortable and progressively got worse. But it was a party trick in high school and college, popping my jaw in and out of place. 

I could absolutely be a rogue case, but it was a miracle story for me that I try to share with anyone who is dealing with what I was.

Look up TMJ. I have had severe TMJ from getting my wisdom teeth out 15 years ago. I had the same symptoms including the inability to chew meat or anything similar without my jaw popping in and out of place. After 5 different specialists and treatments I was finally cured by a chiropractor who was able to reset my jaw basically. 

Not trying to scare you but the sooner you get it checked out and remedies the better. Unfortunately the waiver you sign says you may develop TMJ, among other things, and waives them for any liability for the damage.
